summary: Most of the Brooklyn dossiers held up on history, geography and 2026-27 league facts. The sharpest errors, all fixed: Clover Hill had closed (October 2025). The Navy Yard was named as a practice base in error. Also wrong were the Atlantic Terminal subway-line count, the Barclays ownership and an over-long Biggie lyric quote. Live checks confirmed Atlantic Antic (Sept 27, 2026, possibly moved to Oct 4) and found only dated Brooklyn Circus listings. The strategy brief needs edits. The Nov 3 anniversary is the 14th, and 2026-27 is the 15th season. Still a City must become conditional if the ABA throwbacks are the City Edition. The Paramount-floor launch is unverified, and so are several named doors and partners.
